        Recently Changed

      Grant Criteria 
      This section will outline the application detail including:General grant description including grant value and purpose of the grant. Specific requirements depending on the grant. It would include eligible employers, eligible participant, internship details, eligible and ineligible costs. Best practices based on our research and experience with these programs. E.g. Grant Value: Max. $12,000 per placement or additional salary contribution for interns who are members of an Indigenous group or persons with disabilities. Eligible Employers:Canadian for-profit and non-profit organizations or their subsidiaries100 employees or lessEmployer must have an active payroll accountEligible Participants:Post-secondary graduates (within the last two years)Aged 30 or underUnemployed or underemployedCanadian citizens, Permanent Residents or refugees (work permits not eligible) Cannot be receiving Employment Insurance benefits during the internshipInternship Details:Must be in a field related to their studies. Must be full-time (min. 30 hours per week)Must be between 6 and 12 months in durationGrant covers 50% of wage for 12 months or until maximum is reachedEmployer must have a nepotism policy with respect to the intern Employer must provide on-the-job mentorship and supportEmployer and intern must complete midterm and final reports Reimbursement at mid-point (50%) and upon internship completion (50%)Best PracticesThe program may allow your candidate to start work prior to signing the fianalized copy of the contribution agreement. It typically takes 2-3 business days to draft the final Agreement, during which time your candidate can begin work, if the timeline is pressing.Program  prefers first-time applications Funding will be provided for competing companies
